acceptanceObservation: The packaged desktop creates and manages real campaign projects, provides bounded conversational assistance through managed ChatGPT by default with an explicit API-key backup, authors and compiles semantic content, can turn approved known-size map observations into editable grid-aligned geometry proposals without granting pixels authority, controls exact Foundry operations through approval and reread, and remains usable when AI is offline.
scopeBoundary: One ordered product stage at a time. Stages 1-10 are accepted on their recorded bounded evidence; Stage 11 remains partial/blocked until its governed proposal, approval, history, recovery, packaged/runtime, cross-producer, and authority evidence gates are satisfied; the active stage is scene-authoring-breadth (Stage 12). Stage 12 remains active and non-certifying while its ordered local authoring, cross-plane, runtime, and acceptance gates are evaluated. Desktop Foundry control, campaign content, image-provider benchmarking, and product hardening/release remain pending until their ordered gates become active. Existing stage receipts do not certify unsupported behavior, generic authority, live-world safety, alpha readiness, or Ready-to-Play.
